summary: The mesh-cell and slab estimates correctly bound the original counting fraction for every n,L >= 1 and every simplex rank, including point simplices. The full-dimensional volume estimate and all constants in (1) are valid. The factorial and exponential estimates establish (2) uniformly over the finite simplex collection, and the complete lattice cubes consequently refute the asserted dimension-uniform simplex-capture constant. For every d >= 1, the product body is full-dimensional, has the stated mixed-integer mass, and its legal central point has depth exactly W/2: reflection proves the lower bound even when a halfspace boundary has positive mixed-integer mass, while the continuous-coordinate halfspace attains equality. No mathematical errors or gaps were found.
